---


```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```
```{r}
ggplot(data = mpg, mapping = aes(x = displ, y = hwy)) +
  # Add points, color-coded by class, with slight transparency to handle overlapping
  geom_point(aes(color = class), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  # Add a smooth linear trend line to show the overall negative correlation
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed", se = FALSE) +
  # Apply a vibrant, distinct color palette for the car classes
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  # Customize the text and labels
  labs(
    title = "Engine Displacement vs. Highway Fuel Economy",
    subtitle = "Fuel economy data from 1999 and 2008 for 38 popular car models",
    x = "Engine Displacement (Liters)",
    y = "Highway Fuel Efficiency (mpg)",
    color = "Car Class"
  ) +
  # Use a clean, professional theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  # Fine-tune the title font and legend positioning
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "grey10"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank() # Cleans up background grid
  )
```
